_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. Entries with kind "video" are stills from a creator's ground video, shared with permission (InfraUnfiltered, owner confirmed 2026-11-10); 'date' is then the day the video was published, video_t is the second in the video, and source_url opens the video there. Each still is matched to its station by the creator's spoken station name at that point. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md.

watch_points.title: Mithi river bridge, Kapadia Nagar
watch_points.note: A balanced cantilever bridge takes the line over the Mithi river by Kapadia Nagar, Kurla. On 11 Nov 2026 the arms from the two banks were not yet joined.

photos.caption: Bandra end: the cantilever arm with its traveller

photos.alt: The middle of the bridge over the Mithi seen from the bank: two cantilever arms reach towards each other with a gap between them
photos.caption: Middle: the two arms with a gap still to close

photos.alt: Kurla end of the bridge at Kapadia Nagar: the cantilever arm in green net above shop fronts and a residential building
photos.caption: Kurla end at Kapadia Nagar, in safety net

watch_points.title: Cable-stayed bridge over the railway, Bandra

watch_points.title: Juhu Circle, 185 m gap
watch_points.note: The last 185 m of track, where Line 2B joins Line 2A, curve over two old buildings at Juhu Circle. MMRDA got the plot in a land swap completed in September 2026, but can finish the stretch only after the buildings are vacated and demolished. Until then there are no full track, overhead wire or trial runs from Andheri West. All 12 girders here were in place by 19 Nov 2026 (MMRDA).

photos.alt: Looking up at curved concrete girders over Juhu Circle, on a pier with steel props and a ladder, beside an old, mostly empty building
photos.caption: The girders curve right past the old building that has to come down
